title: Adding an in-product email storage cleanup (backport to releases/29.x)
summary: Payables Agent includes new email storage cleanup functionality accessible via URL parameter, allowing admins to identify and remove duplicate emails from inboxes.
key_points: Adds email storage cleanup UI page available through URL parameter
Includes setup table and duplicate detection buffer table
Provides email inbox row deletion capability
Scheduled cleanup runner with admin-controlled scheduling
Extended Payables Agent admin permission set for access control
